a: Lemifsheta la midderav dimi vela middeabbayye,
Ella meha: chet sheen makkir bo ella hammakom – yom hakkippurim mechapper, uminna: chet sheen makkir bo ella hammakom hu deyom hakkippurim mechapper, aval deyada be – la mechappar.
Veamar rav tachlifa avu derav huna mishshemeh derava: chayyayve malkiyyot sheavar alehen yom hakkippurim – chayyayv. peshita! may shena mechayyayve chattaot vaashamot vaddain?
Salka datach amena: hatam – mamona hu, aval hacha degufa hu – ema la, ka mashma lan.
Veha anan tenan: hoda velo hoda, ase velo taase!
La kashya: ha – deatro beh, ha – dela atro beh.
Ella meatta (siman yoledet metzora nazir sota beegla),
Safek yoledet sheavar aleha yom hakkippurim la tayyte, deha kappar aleh yom hakkippurim, dechet sheen makkir bo ella hammakom hu! amar rav hoshaya: "lechol chattotam" – velo lechol tumeotam.
Ulerabbi shimon ben yochay, deamar yoledet chotet hi, may ikka lememar? yoledet ki ka mayyte korban – leishteroye baachilat kadashim hu, vela lechappara metya.
Amar rav ashe, af anan name tenena: haishsha sheyyesh aleha chattat haof safek, veavar aleha yom hakkippurim – chayyevet lehavi leachar yom hakkippurim, mippene shemachshartah leechol bizvachim.
Ella meatta, sefek metzora sheavar yom hakkippurim la mayyte, deha avar aleh yom hakkippurim, dechet sheen makkir bo ella hammakom hu! amar rabbi oshaya: "lechol chattotam" – velo lechol tumeotam.
Veha amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yochanan: al shiva devarim negaim baim! (siman 9 720) metzora ki mayyte lav lechappara mayyte, ella leishteroye baachilat kadashim hu.
Ella meatta, sefek nazir sheavar alav yom hakkippurim la mayyte korban, deha kappar yom hakkippurim, dechet sheen makkir bo ella hammakom hu! amar rabbi oshaya: lechol chattat" – velo lechol tumea.
Ulerabbi elazar ben hakkappar, deamar: nazir chote hu, may ikka lememar? nazir ki ka mayyte korban, lav lechappara mayyte, leishteroye baachilat kadashim hu.

Ella meatta, sefek sota, sheavar aleha yom hakkippurim la tayyte, deha kappar ala yom hakkippurim, dechet sheeno makkir bo ella hammakom! amar rabbi hoshaya: "lechol chattotam" – velo lechol tumeotam.
Amar abbaye: boel makkir bo. rava amar: sota ki metyay – levarer avon (ka atya).
Ella meatta, egla arufa sheavar aleha yom hakkippurim! vechulei amar abbaye: horeg makkir. rava amar: amar kera: "velaaretz lo yechuppar laddam asher shuppach bah vegomer".
Rav pappa amar: amar kera: "kapper leammecha yisrael vegomer" – reuya kappara zo shettechapper al yotze mitzrayim.

Hasheta deamrat: chet sheen makkir bo ella hammakom yom hakkippurim mechapper, ema: ki mityeyda leh batar yom hakkippurim name la mayyte chattat! amar rabbi zeera: la matzet amrat, dichtiv kera yedia gabbe chattat, vegabbe nesi, vegabbe tzibbur.
Tzerichi, dei ketav kera gabbe yachid, hava amena: kullehon miyyachid la atan, deikka lemifrach: ma leyachid, shekkol korbano nekeva.
Nichtov gabbe nasi, venayyte hanach minnasi!
Yachid minnasi la ate, deikka lemifrach: ma lenasi, shekken en bishmiat kol, tomar beyachid shekken yeshno bishmiat kol!
Vetzibbur minnasi la ate, deikka lemifrach: ma lenasi, shekken bekorbano nekeva!
Nichtov gabbe tzibbur, [venayyte] yachid venasi minna! ikka lemifrach: ma letzibbur, shekken en chayyayvin ella al heelem davar im shiggat maase.
Mechada yedia la atya, tete chada yedia mittarte – la nichtov yedia gabbe yachid, vetete minnasi vetzibbur.
Ikka lemifrach: ma lenasi vetzibbur, shekken enan bishmiat kol, tomar beyachid sheyyeshno bishmiat kol!
La nichtov kera yedia gabbe tzibbur, vetete midia deyachid venasi. ikka lemifrach: ma leyachid venasi shekken yesh bekorba[na]50 nekeva, tomar betzibbur sheen bekorba[na]50 nekeva!
La nichtov gabbe nasi, vetete midia deyachid vetzibbur. may parchat? i mishshum deenan bishmiat hakkol – yachid yochiach, deeno bishmiat hakkol,
Vei mishshum deyesh bechol korbano nekeva – tzibbur yochiach, deen bekorbanan nekeva, ad deit lehon yedia la michayyayv, lema li dichtiv yedia gabbe nasi?
Im eno inyan legufeh, deha atya miyyachid vetzibbur, tenehu inyan lehecha demityeyda leh batar yom hakkippurim, demayyte chattat.
Abbaye amar: i dela ketiv yedia gabbe nasi, miyyachid vetzibbur la ate, mishshum deikka lemifrach: ma leyachid vetzibbur shekken en asuyin lehishtannot, tomar
b: Benasi sheasuy lehishtannot!
Ella amar abbaye, mehacha: mikkede "mitzvot" "mitzvot" yalfi mehadade,

Kevan deyalfi mehadade, lema li dichtiv shalosh yediot gabbe yachid vegabbe nasi vegabbe tzibbur? im eno inyan legufehen, deha gamri lehon "mitzvot" "mitzvot", tenehu inyan hecha demityeyda leh batar yom hakkippurim hu demayyte chattat.

Ema ki mityeyda leh batar yom kippurim hu demayyte chattat, mishshum deyom hakkippurim lav al haden chet ka ate, aval asham taluy, deal haden chet kaate, ema hachi name demikkappar, dechi mityeyda [leh] levatar deka mayyte asham taluy la mayyte chattat.

Amar rava: amar kera: "o hoda elav" – mikkol makom. hasheta deamar: ki mityeyda leh mayyte chattat, asham taluy lamma ba? amar rabbi zera: sheim met, met belo avon. matkef la rava: met, mita memareket! ella amar rava: lehagen alav min hayyissurim.
Chattat haof habba al hassafek. amar rav: vechipper. i hachi, ammay tikkaver?
Lefi sheenah mishtammeret. emat lo mishtammeret? i meikkara – chayya havya! i levassof – kamnattar la!
Ella matnitin benoda lah delo yalda, uvedin hu demutteret bahanaa, umay "tikkaver" – midderabbanan.
Vechi ittemar derav, al haishsha shehevia chattat haof besafek, im ad shello nimleka noda lah sheyyalda vadday – taase vadday, shemmimmin shehevia al lo hoda – mevia al hoda.

Im mishshennimleka noda sheyyalda – amar rav: mazze damah umotze damah, vechippera, [u]mutteret baachila. rabbi yochanan amar: asura baachila, gezera shemma yomru: chattat haof habbaa al hassafek neechelet.
Tane levi kevateh derav: chattat haof habbaa al hassafek, im mishshennimleka noda sheyyalda vadday – mazze damah umotze damah, vechippera, [u]mutteret baachila.

Tanya kevoteh derabbi yochanan: chattat haof habbaa al hassafek, im ad shello nimleka noda lah shello yalda – tetze lechullin, o timmacher lachavertah. im ad shello nimleka noda lah sheyyalda vadday – taase vadday, shemmimmin shemmevia al lo hoda mevia al hoda.
Im mishshennimleka noda sheyyalda – asura afillu bahanaa. sheal hassafek baa mittechillatah, kippera sefekah vehalcha lah.
Mishna hammafrish shene selaim leasham velakach bahen shene elim leasham, im haya echad mehen yafe shete selaim – yikrav laashamo, vehashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava.
Lakach bahen shene elim lechullin, echad yafe shete selaim veechad yafe asara zuz – hayyafe shete selaim yikrav laashamo, vehashsheni – limilato.
Echad leasham veechad lechullin, im haya shel asham yafe shete selaim – yikrav laashamo, vehashsheni limilato, veyavi immah sela vechumeshah.
Gemara may "meilato" dekatane resha, vehashsheni limilato?
Illema el asham, lememra dechomesh bahade ayil mayyte leh? vehachtiv: "veet asher chata min hakkodesh yeshallem veet chamishito yosef alav", alma bahade gezelo mayyte leh!
Veod, katane sefa: echad leasham veechad lechullin, im haya shel asham yafe shete selaim – yikrav laashamo, vehashsheni limilato, veyavi immah sela vechumeshah, alma chomesh bahade gezelo mayyte leh!

Ella, "meilato" – may deithani mehekdesh veyeshno mishte selaim deafreshinnu[50] leasham velakach bahen shene elim lechullin, deyafe shete selaim makrev leh el asham, veyafe asara zuz yahev leh lemay deithani mehekdesh dehave leh gezelo, vechumesho. umay "meilato"? gezelo.
Bemay okemta limilato" deresha – gezelo. ema sefa: echad leasham veechad lechullin, im haya shel asham yafe shete selaim – yikrav laashamo, vehashsheni limila veyavi immah, sela vechumeshah.
Alma "meilato" – el asham. resha kare leh limilato" gezelo,

a: Sefa kare leh limilato" el asham!
Resha, dehave leh ayil rubban keren vechumesho – karu leh limilato" gezelo. sefa, dela have ayil dizvan keren vachomesh – kare leh el asham "meilato", veyavi immah sela vechumeshah.
Bae rav menashsheya bar gadda: bechinnus chumeshin mahu sheyyitkapper?
Mi amrinan: im timtze lomar adam mitkapper bishvach hekdesh – mishshum dekatarach kammeh, aval hacha dela katarach – la mitkapper.

O dilma im timtze lomar en adam mitkapper bishvach hekdesh – mishshum dela afresheh, aval haden kinnus chumeshin – deafresheh, ikka lememar mitkapper. deibbei lehu: [adam] mitkapper bishvach hekdesh, o la?

Ta shema: hammafrish shene selaim leasham, velakach bahen shene elim leasham, haya echad mehen yafe shete selaim – yikrav laashamo, vehashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava.
May lav, dizvan bearbea ayil, ushevach, deshave temanya? ushema minna adam mitkapper bishvach hekdesh! la, hacha vemay askinan? deozel roe gabbeh.
Ta shema: lakach ayil besela, ufittemo veheemido al shetayim – kasher. shema minna adam mitkapper bishvach hekdesh! la, pittemo shane, deha chasar leh temanya.
Ta shema: lakach ayil besela vahare hu bishtayim – kasher. hacha name kesheppittemo.
I hachi hayeynu resha! resha dizvan bearbea veashbecheh bearbea acharine, dechasar leh temanya. sefa dizvan ayil bearbea veashbecheh bitlata, veshave temanya.
I hachi, ema sefa: yeshallem sela – ha chasar leh shiva! may yeshallem? tashlum desela.
Vei sevira leh deen adam mitkapper bishvach hekdesh, ki yahev tashlum desela may have? ayil ben shete selaim baenan, velekka! leolam kasavar: adam mitkapper bishvach hekdesh.
I hachi, tashlum desela lo yitten! hayeynu tama dekayahev tashlumin desela – gezera shemma yomru: ayil pachut mishte selaim mechapper.
May have ala? ta shema: bishat haferasha yafe sela, bishat kappara yafe shete selaim – lo yatza.
Bae rabbi elazar: adam mitkapper bishvach hekdesh, o lo? amar rabbi yochanan: kamma shanim gadal ze benenu, velo shama halacha zo mimmenni!
Mikkelal deamra rabbi yochanan? in, veal hada amra, ditnan: velad toda utemuratah, vechen hammafrish todato veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha, en teuna lechem.
[Rav chananya] mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella leachar kappara, devalad en taun lechem.
Aval lifne kappara – taun lechem, alma kasavar mitkapper bishvach hekdesh.
Bae rabbi elazar: baale chayyim nidchin o lo? amar rabbi yochanan: hare kamma shanim gadal ze benenu, velo shama halacha zo mimmenni!

Mikkelal derabbi yochanan amra? in, deamar rabbi yochanan: behema shel shene shuttafin, hikdish chetzyah, vechazar velakach chetzyah vehikdishah – kedosha, veenah kereva, veosa temura, utemuratah kayyotze bah.
Shema minna telat: shema minna baale chayyim nidchin. ushema minna kedushshat damim medacha. ushema minna yesh dichuy bedamim.
Bae rabbi elazar: huzelu telaim baolam, mahu? mi amrinan "mivchar nidrechem" baenan, veha ikka, o dilma "kesef shekalim" baenan, velekka?

Amar rabbi yochanan: kamma shanim gadalnu bevet hammidrash velo shamanu halacha zo. vela? vehaamar rabbi yochanan amar rabbi shimon ben yochay: mippene ma lo natna tora kitzva bimchussere chappara? shemma yuzelu telaim, veen lahen takkana leechol bekadashim. ema: lo limmadnu halacha zo.
Veha rabbi zera bar adda mahdar talmudeh kol telatin yomin kammeh! ema: lo nitbakkesha halacha zo mimmennu bevet hammidrash.
Gufa, amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: mippene ma lo nittena kitzva bimchussere kappara? shemma yuzelu telaim, veen lahem takkana leechol bekadashim.

Matkef la abbaye: ella meatta, chattat chelev, yinnaten lah kitzva, dilchappara atya velav leishteroye baachilat kadashim hu! matkef la rava: ella meatta, asham nazir leheve leh kitzva, dilvattala hu deate, deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: en lecha davar shehu ba levattala, ella asham nazir bilvad! kashya.
b: Mishna hammafrish chattato vamet – lo yeviennu beno tachtav. lo yeviennu mechet el chet. afillu hifrish al chelev sheachal emesh – lo yevienna al chelev sheachal hayyom, shenneemar: "korbano al chattato" – ad sheyyehe korbano leshem chattato.
Gemara mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "korbano" – bekorbano hu yotze, veeno yotze bekorban aviv.

Yachol lo yetze bekorban aviv bivhema shehifrish aviv, min hakkalla al hachamura, o min hachamura al hakkalla, aval yotze bekorban shehifrish aviv min hakkalla al hakkalla, o min hachamura al hachamura? talmud lomar: "korbano" – bekorbano hu yotze, veeno yotze bekorbano shel aviv.
Yachol lo yetze bekorban aviv bivhema shehifrish, afillu min hakkalla al hakkalla, o min hachamura al hachamura, shehare en megalleach neziruto al behema shehifrish aviv,

Aval yotze bemaot shehifrish aviv, afillu min hakkalla al hachamura, o min hachamura al hakkalla, shehare adam megalleach nezirotav al maot shehifrish aviv, bizman shehen setumim, velo bizman shehen meforashin? talmud lomar: "korbano" – bekorbano hu yotze, veen yotze bekorban aviv.

Yachol lo yetze afillu bemaot shehifrish, afillu min hakkalla al hakkalla o min hachamura al hachamura, aval yotze bekorban shehifrish leatzmo, afillu min hachamura al hakkalla o min hakkalla al hachamura? talmud lomar: "korbano al chattato" – ad sheyyehe leshem chattat.

Yachol lo yetze bekorban atzmo bivhema shehifrish leatzmo, afillu min hakkalla al hakkalla, o min hachamura al hachamura, shekken im hifrish behema al hachelev veheviah al haddam, al haddam veheviah al hachelev – shehare lo maal velo kipper,
Aval yotze bemaot shehifrish leatzmo min hakkalla al hakkalla umin hachamura al hachamura, o min hachamura al hakkalla umin hakkalla al hachamura,
Shekken im hifrish leatzmo maot al hachelev vehevian al haddam, al haddam vehevian al hachelev – shehare maal, vechipper? talmud lomar: "korbano al chattato" – ad sheyyehe korbano leshem cheto.
May lo maal velo kipper? targema rav shemuel bar shimi kammeh derav pappa, hachi kaamar: kevan dela matze mael, kappore name la mechappar, hoil vechach la matze meshanne.
Aval maot, kevan dei meshanne mael umayyte korban meila – ema battechilla name mayyte, ka mashma lan.
Mishna meviin mehekdesh kisba – seira, mehekdesh seira – kisba, umehekdesh kisba useira – torin uvene yona, umehekdesh torin uvene yona – asirit haefa.
Ketzad? hifrish lechisba o lisira, heeni – yavi of, heeni – yavi asirit haefa. hifrish laasirit haefa, heeshir – yavi of, heeshir – yavi kisba useira.
Gemara mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "mechattato", "mechattato", "al chattato", ma talmud lomar?
Minnayin atta omer shemmeviin mehekdesh kisba – seira, umehekdesh seira – kisba, umehekdesh kisba useira – torim uvene yona, umehekdesh torin uvene yona – asirit haefa,
Ketzad? hifrish lechisba velisira veheeni – yavi of, heeni – yavi asirit haefa, hifrish asirit haefa veheeshir – yavi of, heeshir – yavi kisba o seira.
Hifrish kisba o seira venistaavu – yavi bidmehen of, hifrish of venistaev – lo yavi bedamav asirit haefa, sheen laof pidyon.
Lachen neemar "mechattato" "al chattato".

Veitzterich lemichtav "mechattato" gabbe kisba o seira, veitzterich lemichtav gabbe of. dei ketiv kera gabbe hekdesh kisba o seira, hava amena: hifrish kisba, ki miane mehalen maot nachalinnun al of, denayyte of, dechisba vaof tarvayyhu mine damim ninhu.

Aval asirit haefa delav mine dedamim ninhu, i la ketiv kera "mechattato" gabbe of, hava amena: ki mafresh maot lekinno umiane – la mayyte asirit haefa, delav mine dedamim hu, ella mayyte asirit haefa min beteh, vehalen maot deafresh yippelu lindava – ahachi hadar ketiv kera "mechattato" gabbe of, lememra demehekdesh deof name mayyte asirit haefa,
Vehachi kaamar: ki mafrish laasirit haefa, veaddemayyte heeshir – nosef alehon venayyte of, heeshir – nosef alehon venayyte kisba o seira.

Umay tama ketiv "al chattato" gabbe asirit haefa? dei ketayv "al chattato" gabbe of, hava amena: ki mafresh maot lekinno veheeshir – hu demosef alehon umayyte kisba o seira, detarvayyhu mine damim ninhu,

Aval hifrish maot laasirit haefa veheeshir, halen demafresh, i la heeshir tuva – nayyte of, veim heeshir tuva – nayyte kisba o seira, vehalen maot deafresh yippelu lindava, ahachi ketiv kera behaden chattat baashirut vedallut "mechattato", vegabbe dalle dallut "al chattato" – lemidrash kidamrinan.
Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya: metamme mikdash ashir shehifrish ken

a: Lechivsato, veheeni. hoil venidcha – yiddache.
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua, shema mina telat: shema minna baale chayyim nidchim. ukedushshat damim (nidcha).
Vedachuy meikkara have dachuy.
Metiv rav ukeva bar chama: hammafrish nekeva lefischo kodem happesach – tire ad shettistaev, vetimmacher veyavi bedameha pesach. yalda zachar – yire ad sheyyistaev, veyimmacher veyavi bedamav pesach.
Rabbi shimon omer: hu atzmo yikrav pesach. shema minna, baale chayyim enam nidchim!
Amri deve rabbi oshaya: ki amrinan lerabbanan (d)rabbi shimon sevira leh baale chayyim enan nidchin,
Vehagerala enah meakkevet. detanya: met echad mehen – mevi chavero shello behagerala, divre rabbi shimon.
Alma kasavar baale chayyim enan nidchin, vehagerala enah meakkevet.
Amar rav chisda: en hakkinnin mitparshot, ella i bilkichat bealim, i baasiyyayt kohen.
Amar rav shimi bar ashe: may tama derav chisda? dichtiv: "velakcha shete torim vegomer", "veasa hakkohen vegomer" – o bilkichat bealim, o baasiyyayt kohen.
Metivi: "veasahu chattat" – haggoral osehu chattat, veen hashshem osehu chattat, veen kohen ose chattat.
Sheyyachol: vahalo din hu, uma bimkom shello kiddesh haggoral – kiddesh hashshem, mekom shekkiddesh haggoral – eno din sheyyekaddesh hashshem?
Talmud lomar: "veasahu chattat", haggoral osehu chattat, veen hashshem osehu chattat.
Katane shem dumeya degoral: ma goral lav bilkicha velav baasiyyay, af hashshem name lav bilkicha velav baasiyyay!

Amar rav, hachi kaamar: uma bimkom shello kiddesh haggoral bilkichat bealim uvaasiyyayt hakkohen – kiddesh hashshem, i bilkichat bealim i baasiyyayt kohen. kan shekkiddesh haggoral shello bilkicha veshello baasiyyay – eno din shekkiddesh hashshem, i bilkicha i baasiyyay?
Talmud lomar: "veasahu chattat", haggoral osehu chattat, veen hashshem osehu chattat.
Metivi: metamme mikdash ani shehifrish maot lekinno, veheeshir.
Amar "ellu lechattati veellu leolati" – mosif umevi chovato middeme chattato, veen mosif umevi middeme olato.
Veha hacha delekka la lekicha vela asiyyay, vekatane: mevi chovato middeme chattato, vela middeme olato!
Amar rav sheshet: vetisbera matnita metakkanta hi, dekatane "veheeshir"? vehaamar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya: metamme mikdash ashir shehevi korban ani – lo yatza!
Ella, may it lach lememar? shekkevar amar mishsheat aniyyuto, hachi name shekkevar amar mishsheat haferashato.
Ulerabbi chagga amar rabbi oshaya deamar yatza, may ikka lememar? teni: veachar kach lakach veamar.
Metivi: metzora ani shehevi korban ashir – yatza, ashir shehevi korban ani – lo yatza, teyuveta derabbi chagga amar rabbi oshaya!
Amar lach: shane gabbe metzora, demayet rachamana "zot".

I hachi, afillu metzora ani name shehevi korban ashir – lo yatza! laye, ha ahdereh kera "torat". vehatanya: "torat" – lerabbot metzora ani shehevi korban ashir yatza. yachol afillu ashir shehevi korban ani, sheyyatza? talmud lomar: "zot".
Velelaf minneh! amar kera: "veim dal hu veen yado masseget". metzora, hu deashir shehevi korban ani hu delo yatza, aval metamme mikdash ashir shehevi korban ani – yatza.
Mishna rabbi shimon omer: kevasim kodmin et haizzim bechol makom, yachol mippene shehen muvecharim mehem? talmud lomar: "veim keves yavi korbano lechattat" – melammed sheshshenehem shekulin.
Torin kodmin livne yona bechol makom, yachol mippene shehen muvecharim mehen? talmud lomar: "(tor uvene) [uven] yona o tor lechattat" – melammed sheshshenehem shekulin.

Haav kodem laem bechol makom, yachol mippene shekkibbud haav kodem al kibbud haem? talmud lomar: "ish immo veaviv tirau" – melammed sheshshenehem shekulin, aval amru chachamim: haav kodem laem bechol makom, mippene shehu veimmo chayyayvin bichvod aviv.
Vechen betalmud tora, im zacha habben lifne harav – harav kodem et haav bechol makom: mippene shehu veaviv chayyayvin bichvod rabbo.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: arba tzevochot tzavvcha azara. tzevocha rishona: hotziu mikkan vene eli, chofni ufinchas shettimmeu et hahechol.
Tzevocha sheniyya: pitchu shearim veyikkanes yochanan ben nidbay talmido shel pinkay vimalle kereso mikkodshe shamayim. amru al ben nidbay shehaya ochel arbaim sea gozalot
b: Bekinnuach seuda. amru, kol yamav lo haya notar baazara.
Tzevocha shelishit: seu shearim rashechem veyikkanes elishama ben pichay talmido shel pinchas vishammesh bichhunna gedola.
Tzevocha reviit: pitchu shearim vehotziu yissashchar ish kefar barkay, shemmechabbed atzmo umevazze kodshe shamayim. may have aved? hava karech shirae al yedeh vehave aved avoda.
May selika leh? yannay malka umalketa havo yatvin. malka amar: gadya yae, umalketa amra: immera yae, amaru: neshayyeyleh leyissasochar ish kefar barkay, dechohen gadol hu vekim leh kedera.

Shayyluhu, amar lehu: i gadya yae yissak litmida. bahade deamar achvi bideh, amar lehon malka: hoil veachvi bideh, kutzu lideh deyammina. yehev shucheda, katzyu lideh semala. shema malka, amar: liktz[yu] name lideh deyammina. amar rav yosef: berich rachamana deshakleh (l)yissaschar ish kefar barkay lematrafseh.
Amar rav ashe vela hava tene leh. ditnan: kevasim kodmin laizzim bechol makom. yachol mippene shemmuvecharin? talmud lomar: "veim keves", melammed sheshshenehen shekulin keachat.
Ravina amar: afillu mikra name la kera, dichtiv: "im keves", "im ez".
Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina: talmide chachamim marbim shalom baolam, shenneemar: "vechol banayich limmude Adonai verav shelom banayich" [al tikre banecha ella bonayich].
Hadaran alach hammevi asham uselika lah massechet keritut

a: Kodshe kadashim sheshshechatan baddarom – moalin bahen. shechatan baddarom vekibbel daman batztzafon, batztzafon vekibbel daman baddarom,
Shachat bayyom vezarak ballayla, ballayla vezarak bayyom, o sheshshechatan chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo – moalin bahen.
Kelal amar rabbi yehoshua: kol shehaya lah sheat hetter lakkohanim – en moalin bah, vechol shello haya lah sheat hetter lakkohanim – moalin bah.
Ezo hi shehaya lah sheat hetter lakkohanim? shellana, veshennitmea, vesheyyatza.
Veezo hi shello haya lah sheat hetter lakkohanim? shennishchata chutz lizmannah, chutz limkomah, veshekkibbelu pesulin vezarku et dama.
Gemara katane: kodshe kadashim sheshshechatan baddarom – moalin bahen. peshita, mishshum dishchitatan baddarom appekinnun mide meila?
Itzterich, salka datach amena hoil veamar ulla amar rabbi yochanan: kadashim shemmetu – yatzu midde meila devar tora, hachi name kodshe kadashim legabbe darom, kema dechankinnun dame.
Ka mashma lan: kadashim shemmetu – la chazu kelal. aval darom – nehi deeno rauy lekodshe kadashim, aval rauy hu lekadashim kallim.
Lema li lemitne kol hane?

Tzerichi: i tena shechatan baddarom vekibbel daman batztzafon, hacha deit behu meila, mishshum dekabbala batztzafon hu. aval shechatan batztzafon vekibbel daman baddarom, hoil vekibbel baddarom hu – nafek mide meila.
Vei tena hay, hava amena: yemama zeman hakerava hu, aval shechatah ballayla vezarak bayyom – layla lav zeman hakerava, vehay deshachet ballayla – denafek mide meila!

Vei tena shechatah ballayla, hava amena: hoil vekibbel dama bayyom – it ba meila, aval shechatan bayyom vezarak daman ballayla, hoil velav zeman hakerava hu – keman dechankinnun dame, vela it behu meila, kamashma lan.
Chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo. lemay chazu?
Hoil umeratztzin lefiggulin.
b: Ibbaya lehu: i alu, mahu sheyyerdu? rabba amar: im alu – yerdu, rav yosef amar: im alu – lo yerdu.
Allibba derabbi yehuda la tibbee lach, dechulle alma la peligi deim alu – yerdu. ki peligi allibba derabbi shimon.
Rav yosef kerabbi shimon. rabba amar lach: ad kan la kaamar rabbi shimon ella bannittanin lematta shennetanan lemala o bannittanin lemala shennetanan lematta,
Uleolam dishchatan vekibbel daman batztzafon, aval hacha, kevan dishchatan baddarom – keman dechankinnun dame.
Tenan: kodshe kadashim sheshshechatan baddarom – moalin bahen. bishlama lerav yosef nicha, ella lerabba kashya! may moalin bahen – midderabbanan.
May ikka ben deorayyta lerabbanan? deorayyta meshallemin chomesh, derabbanan – la.
Umi ikka meila midderabbanan? in, deamar ulla amar rabbi yochanan: kadashim shemmetu – yatzu mide meila, devar tora. alma middeorayyta la it lehon, bidrabbanan it behon. hachi name – midderabbanan.
Lema tenena leha deulla amar rabbi yochanan! af al gav ditnena, itzterich deulla, salka datach amena, hacha la bedilin minnehon,
Aval kadashim shemmetu, hoil uvedilin minnehon, ema: afillu meila midderabbanan la, ka mashma lan.
Metu – name tenena: hannehene min hachattat keshehi chayya – lo maal ad sheyyifgom. ucheshehi meta, kevan denehena kol shehu – maal.
Salka datach

a: Amena: chattat, hoil ulechappara ka atya – la bedilin minna, aval kadashim, hoil velav lechappara kaate – bedili minnehon, velet behu meila, ka mashma lan.
Vechattat shemmeta mi it ba meila? vehatnan: chattaot hammetot umaot haholchot leyam hammelach – lo nehenin velo moalin!
Amri: chattaot hammetot – bechayyehen bedilin minnehon, leappoke hecha demechayyim – dela bedilin minneh.
Etiveh rav yosef lerabba chada miggo chada, vachada miggo chada:
Vechullan, en metammeim begadim abbet habbelia umoalin bahen,
Chutz mechattat haof sheasa lematta, kemaase chattat haof leshem chattat.
Vekatane illaveh: kol shehaya pesulo bakkodesh – eno metamme begadim abbet habbelia, vechol shello haya pesulo bakkodesh – metamme begadim abbet habbelia.
Vekatane: kol shehaya pesulo bakkodesh – im alu, lo yerdu. teyuveta derabba! teyuveta.
Veha difligi ba rabba verav yosef peshita leh lerabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar: olat bamat yachid, shehichnisah lifnim –
b: Kelatuha mechitzot lechol davar.
Bae rabbi elazar: [olat bamat yachid shehichnisah, shennifsela] – alu, mahu sheyyerdu?
Middekamibbaya leh lachada, mikkelal deiddach peshita leh, i kerabba i kidrav yosef.
Chada miggo chada kamibbaya leh:
Ad kan la kaamar rabba hatam im alu – yerdu, mechitza ketiknah –
Pasla, shello ketiknah – lo pasla,
O dilma: afillu lerav yosef deamar im alta – lo tered, mechitza ketiknah – kalta, shello ketiknah – la kalta. teku.
Amar rav giddel amar rav: zerikat piggul eno motzi mide meila bekodshe kadashim, veeno mevi lide meila bekadashim kallim.
Yetev abbaye vekaamar la leha shemata, etiveh rav pappa leabbaye: hashshochet et hattoda lifnim, velachmah chutz lachoma – lo kiddesh et hallechem.
Shechatah ad shello karmu paneha battannur, vaafillu karmu kullan chutz meachat mehen – lo kadash hallechem. shechatah chutz lizmannah vechutz limkomah – kadash hallechem.
Alma piggul mayyte la lide meila! ishtik.
Ki ata lekammeh derabbi abba, amar leh: bizrika.
Amar leh rav ashe lerava: veha amar ulla: kometz piggul sheheelo legabbe mizbeach – paka piggulo mimmennu,
Ukemitza hayeynu shechita!
Amar leh: issura demayyte lide figgul.

a: Veha katane: im acherim mevi lide piggul, hu atzmo lo kol shekken!
Ha name, issura demayyte lide piggul.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: vehaamar ilfa: machaloket bishte avodot,
Kegon deamar "hareni shochet siman rishon chutz lizmanno, vesiman sheni chutz limkomo", aval baavoda achat – dechulle alma eruve machshavot havay!
Hachi name, lechi zarek tiggalle milleta. i baavoda achat, i bishte avodot.
I hachi, gabbe toda name, ad dezarek!
May "kadash" – lippasel, devae serefa.
Lema mesayyay leh: happiggul leolam moalin bo. lav af al gav deizzerik dam, umesayyay leh!
La, delo zarak haddam. i delo zarak haddam, may lememra?
Ella: leolam dezarek, vechi tanya hahi, beola. i beola, peshita, degavoah hi kulla.
b: Veod, dekatane sefa: lan damah, af al pi shechazar uzerako – moalin bo.
I amrat bishlama bechattat – shappir.
Ella i amrat beola – tzericha lememar?
Sefa vadday mesayyay leh. resha, may? hoil umesayyay leh sefa, mesayyay leh name resha?
Sefa lav vadday mesayyay leh: may shena halana – dekaaved beyadayim, la mahne zerika leappoke mide meila.
Machshava – la ka aved beyadayim, mahne leh zerika leappoke mide meila.
Lema ha mesayyay leh: happiggul bekodshe kadashim – moalin bo. lav af al gav dezarak umesayyay leh! la, delo zarak.
Aval zarak, may? hachi name deen moalin bo? ammay katane sefa: bekadashim kallim – en moalin bo?
Liflog beresha, velitne: lifne zerika – moalin bo, leachar zerika – en moalin bo! hahu vadday mesayyay leh.
Lema hoil umesayyay leh sefa mesayyay leh name resha? kadashim kallim – pesika leh, hacha – la pesika leh.
Kelal amar rabbi yehoshua: kol shehayta lah sheat hetter lakkohanim – en moalin bah, vechol shello hayta lah sheat hetter lakkohanim – moalin bah.
Ezohi shehayta lah sheat hetter lakkohanim? shellana, veshennitmet, vesheyyatzat.
Veezohi shello hayta lah sheat hetter lakkohanim? shennishchata chutz lizmannah, vechutz limkomah, veshekkibbelu pesulin vezarku et damah.
Amar leh bar kappara levar pedat: ben achoti, ree ma atta shoaleni lemachar bevet hammidrash: hetter shechita shaninu,

a: O hetter zerika shaninu, o hetter achila shaninu? chizkiyya amar: hetter shechita shaninu, rabbi yochanan amar: hetter achila shaninu.
Amar rabbi zera: la dayyka matnitin dela kechizkiyya udela kerabbi yochanan.
Tenan: shellana, veshennitmet, vesheyyatzat. lav delan dam, vekatane: en moalin bo,
Ushema minna: hetter zerika shaninu!
La, delan basar, aval dam izderik, mishshum hachi katane: en moalin bo.
Tenan: veezo hi shello hayta lah sheat hakkosher lakkohanim? shennishchata chutz lizmannah, vechutz limkomah, veshekkibbelu pesulin vezarku et damah.
Hechi dame, illema dizrakuhu pesulin vekibbeluhu pesulin – lema li ad deikka tarte?
Ella lav dekibbeluhu pesulin uzerakuhu kesherim, vekatane moalin bo,
Shema minna: hetter zerika shaninu.
Matkef la rav yosef: vei salka datach ikka lefalloge hachi, ha ditnan hatam:
Chattat pesula – en damah taun kibbus, ben shehayta lah sheat hakkosher venifsela, uven shello hayta lah sheat hakkosher venifsela.
I zo hi shehayta lah sheat hakkosher venifsela? shellana, veshennitmet, o sheyyatza.
Ezohi shello hayta lah sheat hakkosher? shennishchata chutz limkomah, chutz lizmannah, veshekkibbelu pesulin vezarku et damah.
Hechi dame? illema dekibbeluhu pesulin vezarku pesulin – hu deen damah taun kibbus, ha kibbeluhu vezarku kesherim – damah taun kibbus.
Keri kan: "asher yizze middamah" – velo shekkevar huzza? ella: lav davka,
b: Hachi name, lav davka. amar rav assi: im ken, lema li lemitne tarte?
Ella leolam dimila davka,
Veha ka mashma lan: defasul ose shirayim,
Af al gav dekibbel pasul vezarak, vekibbel kasher vezarak – lav kelum hi. may tama? deshirayim ninhu.
Veha bea minneh resh lakish merabbi yochanan: pasul, mahu sheyyaase shirayim?
Vaamar leh: en lecha davar sheyyaase shirayim ella chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo, hoil umeratztzin lefiggulan.
May lav, bar mippasul? la, afillu pasul.
Veha "en lecha" katane!
Hachi katane: en lecha davar sheeno meratztze betzibbur veose shirayim ella chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo, aval tame, deiteh betzibbur – meshavve shirayim,
Shear pesulin dela itannun betzibbur – la meshavvin shirayim.
Ta shema: happiggul – leolam moalin bo.
Lav delo zarak, ushema minna: hetter zerika shaninu!
La, zarke.
Umay "leolam"? ha ka mashma lan kidrav giddel, deamar rav giddel amar rav: zerikat piggul – eno motzi mide meila, veeno mevi lide meila.

a: Ta shema, rabbi shimon omer: yesh notar shemmoalin bo, veyesh notar sheen moalin bo.
Ketzad? lan lifne zerika – moalin, leachar zerika – en moalin.
Katane mihat: moalin bo, lav dahava shehut lemizrekeh, dei bae – zarek,
Ushema minna: hetter achila shaninu!
La, dekabbeleh samuch lishkiat hachamma, delo haya shehut lemizrak.
Aval haya shehut, may? hachi name deen moalin?
May irya detane "lifne zerika", litne "kodem shekia" uleachar shekia"!
Hachi name katane: kodem sheyyerae lizrika, uleachar sheyyerae lizrika.
Ta shema, rabbi shimon omer: yesh piggul shemmoalin bo, veyesh piggul sheen moalin bo.
Ketzad? lifne zerika – moalin, leachar zerika – en moalin.
Katane mihat: lifne zerika – moalin bo, lav dahava shehut lemizrekeh, dei bae – zarek, vekatane "moalin bo", ushema minna: hetter achila shaninu!
La, dela hava shehut lemizrekeh. aval hava shehut lemizrekeh, may? hachi name dinfak mide meila?
May irya detane "leachar zerika", litne "kodem shekia" uleachar shekiat hachamma"!
Hachi name kaamar: kodem sheyyerae lizrika, leachar sheyyerae lizrika.
Ta shema: happiggul bekodshe kadashim – moalin. may lav dezarak, ushema minna: hetter achila shaninu! la, delo zarak.
Aval zarak may? hachi name deen moalin bo? may irya detane bekadashim kallim en moalin bo,
Litne: kan – lifne zerika, kan – leachar zerika!
Ha atya leashmoinan: kol leetoye lide meila, zerika ketiknah mayyte lide meila.
Kol leappoke mide meila, afillu shello ketiknah name mafka mide meila.
b: Mishna besar kodshe kadashim sheyyatza lifne zerikat damim,
Rabbi eliezer omer: moalin bo, veen chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul venotar vetame.
Rabbi akiva omer: en moalin bo, vechayyayvin alav mishshum piggul venotar vetame.
Amar rabbi akiva: vahare hammafrish chattato veavda, vehifrish acheret tachteha, veachar kach nimtzet harishona, vahare shetehen omdot.
Lo keshem sheddamah poter et besarah, kach hu poter et besar chavertah?
Im patar damah et besar chavertah min hammeila, din hu sheyyiftor et besar atzmah!
Emuray kadashim kallim sheyyatzu lifne zerikat damim,
Rabbi eliezer omer: en moalin bahen, veen chayyayvin alehen mishshum piggul notar vetame. rabbi akiva omer: moalin bahen, vechayyayvin alehen mishshum piggul notar vetame.
Gemara vehane tarte lema li?
Tzerichi, dei ittemar bekodshe kadashim, hava amena: beha ka amar rabbi eliezer moalin bo, mishshum dizrika ketiknah mappeka mide meila, shello ketiknah – la mappeka mide meila.
Aval leetoye lide meila – mode lerabbi akiva daafillu shello ketiknah mayyta lide meila,
Vei ittemar gabbe kadashim kallim, hava amena: gabbe kadashim kallim hu deamar rabbi akiva moalin bahen, daafillu zerika shello ketiknah mayyta lide meila,
Aval kodshe kadashim, dilappoke hu, shello ketiknah – la mappeka mide meila, ka mashma lan.
Ittemar, amar rabbi yochanan: ki amar rabbi akiva zerika moelet layyotze – sheyyatza miktzato, aval yotze kullo – lo amar rabbi akiva.
Amar leh rav assi lerabbi yochanan: kevar limmeduni chaveray shebbaggola

a: Mechashshevin al haavud veal hassaruf.
Veha avud vesaruf la itinnun baolam, vaafillu hachi katane mechashshevin!
Umi amar rav assi hachi? ha bea minneh rav assi merabbi yochanan: chishshev lannishpachin, lemachar, mahu?
Amar leh rabbi zera: kevar shanita lanu alal! alma hay alal, kevan delet beh meshasha – lo kibbel tumea,
Hane nishpachin name, kevan dilibbud azli – behu machshava la mahneya!
Ella dekatane al haavud veal hassaruf – kashya! amar rava: ema: al haomed leibbud veal haomed lissaref.
Amar rav pappa: la amar rabbi akiva zerika moelet layyotze ella sheyyatza basar, aval dam – en zerika moelet layyotze.
Tanya name hachi: shachat bishtika veyatza dam, af al pi shechazar uzerako – lo asa velo chelum. bekodshe kadashim – moalin bo, bekadashim kallim – en moalin bo.
Amar rabbi akiva: ha ze, lema dome?
Amar rabbi elazar: ki amar rabbi akiva, bevat achat, aval beze achar ze – lo amar rabbi akiva.

Tanya, amar rabbi shimon: keshehalachti lichfar pani, metzaani zaken echad veamar li: omer haya rabbi akiva zerika moelet layyotze? amarti lo: hen. ucheshebbati vehirtzeti devarim lifne chaveray shebbaggalil, amru li: halo pasul hu, heach meratztze al happasul?

Uchesheyyatzati vehirtzeti devarim lifne rabbi akiva, amar li: beni, i atta omer ken? vahare hammafrish chattato veavda, vehifrish acheret tachteha, veachar kach nimtzet harishona, vahare shetehen omdot – moalin bishtehen. shechatan, vahare daman munnach bechosot – moalin bishtehen.
b: Nizrak dam shel echad mehem, i atta mode shekkeshem sheddamah poter et besarah min hammeila, af yiftor besar chavertah min hammeila?
Im hitztzil besar chavertah min hammeila, af al pi shehu pasul, din hu sheyyatztzil et besarah!
Amar resh lakish mishshum rav oshaya: teshuva genuva heshivo rabbi akiva leoto talmid, bevat achat – in, beze achar ze – la,
Dechevan defasul hu, ma li bevat achat, ma li beze achar ze?!
Amar leh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: veatta, i atta omer ken?
Illu hifrish shete ashamot leachrayut, veshachat et shenehen, vekadam veheela emurin shel echad mehen kodem zerika, i atta mode sheim alu – yerdu?
Vei salka datach chad gufa hu, ammay im alu – yerdu? haamar ulla: emure kadashim kallim sheheelan lifne zerikat dam – lo yerdu, naasa lachmo shel mizbeach!
Ishtik. amar rabbi yochanan: katztzetztinnun leraglohi deyanoka.
Mishna yesh maase damim bekodshe kadashim lehakel ulehachamir, uvekadashim kallim kullehu lehachamir.
Ketzad? kodshe kadashim lifne zerikat damim – moalin beemurehen uvabbasar. leachar zerikat damim – moalin beemurehen, veen moalin babbasar.
Veal ze veal ze – chayyayv mishshum piggul, notar, vetame. nimtza, maase damim bekodshe kadashim lehakel ulehachamir,
Uvekadashim kallim kullan lehachamir. ketzad? kadashim kallim lifne zerikat damim – en moalin lo baemurin velo babbasar, leachar zerikat damim – moalin baemurin veen moalin babbasar.
Al ze veal ze chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul, notar, vetame. nimtza maase damim bekadashim kallim kullan lehachamir.
Gemara katane "en moalin babbasar" – meila hu delekka, ha issura ikka, veammay? ha mamona dechohen hu!
La kashya, mishshum denasev resha "moalin", nasev sefa "en moalin".

Ema sefa: "bekadashim kallim kullehu lehachamir. ketzad? besar kadashim kallim lifne zerikat damim – en moalin bahen uveemurehen, veen chayyayvin alehen mishshum piggul, notar, vetame. leachar zerikat damim – moalin beemurehen veen moalin babbasar".
Meila hu delekka, ha issura ikka, veammay? ha mamona divalim hu!
Amar rabbi chanina: layyotzin, verabbi akiva hi.
Ki amar rabbi akiva zerika moelet, layyotze lisrefa,

a: Aval laachila hu delo meratztza.
Haderan alach kodshe kadashim
Chattat haof moalin bah mishshehukedsha, nimleka – hucheshra lehippasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvelina.
Huzza damah – chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul, notar, vetame, veen bah meila.
Gemara katane hucheshra lippasel bitvul yom, uvimchussar kippurim, uvelina. lippasel – in, aval letammoye – la.
Matnitin manni? rabbanan hi, detanya: abba shaul omer: tevul yom
b: Techilla lakkodesh.
Rabbi meir omer: metamme et hakkodesh, ufosel et hatteruma. vachachamim omrim: keshem shehu posel mashke teruma veochle teruma, kach hu posel mashke kodesh veochle kodesh.
Amar rava: leabba shaul maala asu bakkodashim, shavvinhu rabbanan litvul yom karishon,
Lerabbi meir keochel sheni. lerabbanan, kevan ditval – kelash tumea, pasul – meshavve, tame – la meshavve.
Huzza damah – chayyayvin kulei. meila hu delekka, aval issura – ikka. veammay? ha mamona dechohanim hu!
Amar rabbi chanina: layyotzin, verabbi akiva hi, deamar zerika moelet layyotze, delav bat achila hi.
Amar rav huna amar rav: mitztzuy chattat haof – eno meakkev. detane rav: "huzza damah".
Rav adda bar ahava amar rav: mitztzuy chattat haof meakkev. vetane rav: "mitztza damah".

Ta shema: "vehannishar baddam yimmatze el yesod hammizbeach chattat hi". bishlama lerav adda bar ahava, hayeynu dichtiv: "vehannishar baddam yimmatze... chattat hi", ella lerav huna, may "vehannishar"?
Kidtanya deve rabbi yishmael: sheim nishar. umay "chattat hi"? aresha.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: ella meatta, gabbe mincha dichtiv: "vehannoteret". hachi name sheim nittotar? vechi tema: hachi name,

a: Vehatanya: "missoltah umishshamnah al kol levonatah" – perat shechasra soltah vechasra shamnah vechasra levonatah!
Amri: hatam ketiv "vehannoteret", kera yattira ketiv.

Metiv avu dishmuel lerav huna: echad chattat haof veechad olat haof shemmelakan umitztza daman chutz limkoman – pasul veen bo karet. chutz lizmannan – piggul vechayyayvin alav karet. katane mihat mitztza daman!
Hu motev la vehu mefarek la: litzdadin katane.
Gufa, tana deve rabbi yishmael: sheim nishar baddam.
Veha tana deve rabbi yishmael hatam: shirayim meakkevin, veamar rav pappa: mitztzuy chattat haof ikka benayyhu! tere tannae, veallibba derabbi yishmael.

Mishna olat haof – moalin bah mishshehukedsha. nimleka – hucheshra lippasel bitvul yom, uvimchussar kippurim, uvelina. mitza damah – chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul, notar, vetame. umoalin bah ad shettetze levet haddeshen.

Parim hannisrafim, useirim hannisrafim – moalin bahen mishshehukedshu. nishchatu – hucheshru lippasel bitvul yom, uvimchussar kippurim, uvelina. huzza daman – chayyayvin alehen mishshum piggul, notar, vetame, umoalin bahen bevet haddeshen ad sheyyattich habbasar.

Haola – moalin bah mishshehukedsha. nishchata – hucheshra lippasel bitvul yom, uvimchussar kippurim, uvelina. mishshennizrak damah – chayyayvin aleha mishshum piggul, notar, vetame. veen moalin baorot, aval moalin babbasar ad shettetze levet haddeshen.

Chattat, veasham, vezivche shalme tzibbur – moalin bahen mishshehukedshu. nishchatu – hucheshru lippasel bitvul yom, uvimchussar kippurim, uvelina. nizrak daman – chayyayvin alehen mishshum piggul, notar, vetame. en moalin babbasar, aval moalin beemurehen ad sheyyetzu levet haddeshen.

Shete hallechem – moalin bahen mishshehukedshu. karmu battannur – hucheshru lippasel bitvul yom, uvimchussar kippurim, uvelina, velishchot alehen et hazzevach. nizrak daman shel kevasim – chayyayvin alehen mishshum piggul, notar, vetame, veen bahen meila.
Lechem happanim – moalin bo mishshehukedsha. karam battannur – hucheshar lippasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim, ulehissader al gabbe hashshulechan.
Karvu habbazikkin – chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul, notar, vetame, veen bo meila.
Hammenachot – moalin bahen mishshehukedshu. kadshu bichli – hucheshru lippasel bitvul yom, uvimchussar kippurim, uvelina.
Karav hakkometz – chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul, notar, vetame. veen moalin bashshirayim, aval moalin bakkometz ad sheyyetze levet haddeshen.
Gemara ittemar, hannehene meefer tappuach sheal gabbe hammizbeach, rav amar: en moalin bo, verabbi yochanan amar: moalin bo.
Lifne terumat haddeshen kulle alma la peligi demoalin bo. ki peligi – leachar terumat haddeshen.
Rav amar: en moalin bo – hare naasa mitzvato. verabbi yochanan amar: kevan dichtiv: "velavash hakkohen middo vad vegomer" – kevan ditzrich levigde chehunna, bikdushsheteh kae.
Tenan: moalin bahen ad shettetze levet haddeshen, kashya lerav! amar lecha rav: ad shetterae levet haddeshen.
b: Metivi: vechullan, sheppaku meal gabbe hammizbeach – lo yachazir, vechen gachelet sheppaka meal gabbe hammizbeach – lo yachazir. ha al gabbe hammizbeach – yachazir.
Bishlama lerabbi yochanan, nicha, ella lerav, kashya! amar lecha rav: shane gachelet, deit bay meshasha.
Ikka deamar la lehach gisa: tama mishshum gachelet, deit bay meshasha, ha efer delet beh meshasha, afillu legabbe mizbeach – en moalin bo. bishlama lerav, nicha, ella lerabbi yochanan, kashya!
Amar lach rabbi yochanan: hu haddin daafillu efer, vehayeynu tama dekatane gachelet – kaate leashmoinan daafillu gachelet, deit ba meshasha, ki paka meal gabbe hammizbeach – lo yachazir.

Ittemar: hannehene mibbesar kodshe kadashim lifne zerikat damim, veemure kadashim kallim leachar zerikat damim, rav amar: ma shennehena – yippelu lindava. velevi amar: yavi davar shekkullo lammizbeach.
Tanya kevoteh delevi: meila zo lehechan holechet? hallemedin lifne chachamim omrim: yavi davar shekkullo lammizbeach. may nihu? ketoret.

Tanya kevoteh derav: hannehene middeme chattat umiddeme asham, ad shello karva chattato – yosif veyavi chattato. vead shello karva ashamo – yosif veyavi ashamo. karav chattato – yelchu leyam hammelach. kevar karav ashamo – yippelu lindava.

Hannehene mikkodshe kadashim lifne zerikat damim, veemure kadashim kallim leachar zerikat damim – ma shennehena yippelu lindava. kol korbenot hammizbeach – lammizbeach. korbenot kodshe bedek habbayit – levedek habbayit. korbenot tzibbur – lenidvat tzibbur.

Ha gufa kashya, ad shello karva chattato – yosif veyavi chattato, mishshekkarva chattato – yelchu leyam hammelach. vekatane kol korbenot hammizbeach – lammizbeach, vela shena deikkappur bealim, vela shena hecha dela ikkappur!
Resha rabbi shimon hi, deamar: kol chattat shekkipperu bealeha – tamut.

a: Vesefa rabbanan?! amar rav geviha deve chetil lerav ashe, hachi amar abbaye: resha rabbi shimon vesefa rabbanan.
Amar rava: hakkol modim sheim nehena mibbesar kodshe kadashim shennitma kodem zerika, umeemuray kadashim kallin leachar sheheelan, defatur.
Peshita, may ka mafsed?
Mahu detema besar kodshe kadashim shennitma – it leh mitzvat serefa lechohanim, emure kadashim kallin – ikka mitzva lehappoche betzinnora, ka mashma lan dela.
Amar rava: ha deamrat "kevar karva chattat yelchu leyam hammelach", hane mille deityeda leh kamme kappara, aval leachar kappara – yippelu lindava. may tama? en mafrishin mittechilla leibbud.
Mishna, hakkometz, vehallevona, vehakketoret, uminchat kohanim, uminchat kohen mashiach, uminchat nesachim – moalin bahem mishshehukedshu.
Kiddeshan bichli – hucheshar lippasel bitvul yom, uvimchussar kippurim, uvelina, vechayyayvin alav mishshum notar, umishshum tame ufiggul en bah.
Ze hakkelal: kol sheyyesh lo mattirin – en chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul venotar vetame ad sheyyakrivu mattirin.
Vechol sheen lo mattirin, kevan shekkiddesh bichli – chayyayvin alav mishshum notar vetame, ufiggul en bah.
b: Gemara mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: yachol en chayyayvin mishshum tumea ella bedavar sheyyesh lo mattirin?
Vedin hu: uma piggul shehu bidia achat, vekorbano kavua, velo huttar mikkelalo – en chayyayvin ella al davar sheyyesh lo mattirin,
Tumea, shehi bishte yediot, vekorbano ole veyored, vehuttera mikkelalah – eno din shello yehe chayyayv ella al davar sheyyesh lo mattirin?!
Talmud lomar: "emor alehem ledorotechem kol ish asher yikrav mikkol zarachem vegomer" – bechol hakkodashim hakkatuv medabber. yachol yehu chayyayvin alehen miyyad? talmud lomar: "asher yikrav".

Amar rabbi elazar: vechi yesh nogea shehu chayyayv?! ha ketzad? kol davar sheyyesh lo mattirin – eno chayyayv ad sheyyikrevu mattirin, vechol davar sheen lo mattirin – eno chayyayv ad sheyyikdash bichli.

Haderan alach chattat haof

.
Velad chattat, utemurat chattat, vechattat shemmetu bealeha – yamutu,
Vesheibbera shenatah, vesheavda venimtzet baalat mum, im mishshekkipperu habbealim – tamut. veenah osa temura, velo nehenin velo moalin.

a: Veim ad shello kipperu habbealim – tire ad shettistaev, vetimmacher veyikchu bedameha acheret. veose temura, umoalin bah.
Gemara may shena resha dela ka mippalgi, umay shena sefa deka mippalgi?
Resha – pesika leh, sefa – la pesika leh.
Ha tena leh gabbe temura! tena hatam mishshum temura, tena hacha mishshum meila.
Mishna hammafrish maot linziruto – lo nehenin velo moalin, mippene shehen reuyin lavo kullan shelamim.
Met vehayu lo maot setumin – yippelu lindava. maot meforashim, deme chattat – yelchu leyam hammelach, lo nehenin velo moalin.
Deme ola – yaviu ola, umoalin bahen. deme shelamim – yaviu shelamim, veneechalin leyom echad. veen teunin lechem.
Gemara matkef la resh lakish: velitne name: hammafrish maot lekinnim –
Lo nehenin velo moalin, mippene shehen reuyin lehavi torin shello higgia zemannan uvene yona sheavar zemannan!
Amar rava: amra tora bemaot setumin: have shelamim, amra tora: have torin shello higgia zemannan? enan reuyin lammizbeach!
Mishna rabbi shimon omer: haddam – kal battechilla vechamur besofo. nesachin – chomer bitchillatan vekal besofan.
Dam, bitchillato – en moalin. yatza lenachal kidron – moalin bo. nesachin bitchillatan – moalin bahen. yardu lashshitin – en moalin bahen.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: moalin bedamim, divre rabbi meir verabbi shimon. vachachamim omrim: en moalin.
May tama deman deamar en moalin? amar ulla: amar kera: "vaani netattiv lachem" – shellachem hu. deve rabbi yishmael tana: "lechapper" – lechappara netattiv, velo limila.
Rabbi yochanan amar, amar kera: "ki haddam hu bannefesh yechapper" – lifne chappara kilachar kappara hu. ma leachar kappara en bo meila, af lifne chappara en bo meila.
Veema: ma lifne chappara – yesh bo meila, af leachar kappara – yesh bo meila!
Vechi yesh lecha davar shennaaset mitzvato veyesh bo meila? ammay la?!
b: Hare terumat haddeshen, shennaasa mitzvato, veyesh bo meila!
Mishshum dehave leh terumat haddeshen veevre sair hammishtalleach shene ketuvin habbain keechad, vechol shene chetuvin habbain keechad – en melammedin.
Hanicha leman deamar evre sair hammishtalleach – en nehenin mehen, ella leman deamar nehenin mehen, may ikka lememar?!
Mishshum dehave leh terumat haddeshen uvigde chehunna shene chetuvin habbain keechad, vechol shene chetuvin habbain keechad – en melammedin.
Hanicha lerabbanan deamri: "vehinnicham sham" – melammed shehen teunin geniza, shappir.
Ella lerabbi dosa, deamar: muttar lehishtammesh bahen kohen hedyot, may ikka lememar?
Mishshum dehave terumat haddeshen veegla arufa shene chetuvin habbain keechad.
Hanicha leman deamar en melammedin, ella leman deamar melammedin, may ikka lememar?
Tere miute ketivi. ketiv hatam: "haarufa",
Uchetiv hatam "vesamo etzel hammizbeach", hane – in, midde acharina – la.
Nesachim battechilla moalin bahen [vechulei]. lema matnitin dela kerabbi elazar bar rabbi tzadok,

Detanya, rabbi elazar bar rabbi tzadok omer: lul katan haya ben kevesh lammizbeach, bemaaravo shel kevesh. achat leshivim shana pirche chehunna yordin bo, umeviin yayin karush, shehu dome leiggule devela, vesorfin otah bikdushsha. shenneemar: "bakkodesh hassech nesech shechar laAdonai" – keshem shennissuchah bikdushsha, kach serefatah bikdushsha.
May mashma? veamar ravina: atya "kodesh" "kodesh". ketiv hacha: "bakkodesh", uchetiv hatam: "vesarafta et hannotar baesh velo yochal ki kodesh hem",
Ma notar – serefato bikdushsha, af hay name bikdushsha!
Afillu tema rabbi elazar bar rabbi tzadok, dei kelat.
Ikka deamri: lema matnitin kerabbi elazar bar rabbi tzadok, dei kelat?
Amri: la, umidderabbanan. veha kera kanasev la? asmachta.

Mishna dishshun mizbeach happenimi, vehammenora – lo nehenin velo moalin. hammakdish dishshun battechilla – moalin bah. torin shello higgia zemannan, uvene yona sheavar zemannan – lo nehenin velo moalin.
Gemara bishlama

a: Mizbeach hachitzon, dichtiv beh: "vesamo etzel hammizbeach". mizbeach happenimi menalan?
Amar rabbi elazar: deamar kera: "vehesir et murato benotzatah" – im eno inyan lemizbeach hachitzon, tenehu inyan lemizbeach happenimi.
Ema: idde veidde bemizbeach hachitzon, velikboa lo makom!
Im ken, lema kera: "etzel hammizbeach". may "haddashen"? daafillu mizbeach happenimi.
Menora menalan? "dashen", "haddashen".
Mishna rabbi shimon omer torin shello higgia zemannan – moalin bahen, bene yona sheavar zemannan – lo nehenin velo moalin bahen.
Gemara bishlama rabbi shimon, kidkatane tama: shehaya rabbi shimon omer, kol harauy leachar zeman, vehikdisho betoch zemanno – hare hu belo taase, veen bo karet.
Ella rabbanan: may shena mimmechussar zeman?
Amri: mechussar zeman – midde dehave abbaal mum, devar pidyon hu. aval hane ofot, kevan deen mum posel beofot – en laofot pidyon.
Amar ulla, amar rabbi yochanan: kadashim shemmetu, yatzu mide meila devar tora.
Yatev ulla vekaamar leha shemata, amar leh rav chisda: man shama lach ulerabbi yochanan rabbach?! vechi kedushsha shebbahen lehechan halcha?!
Amar leh: tikshe matnitin: "torin shello higgia zemannan uvene yona sheavar zemannan – lo nehenin velo moalin", hacha name nema: kedushsha shebbahen lehechan halcha?!
Amar leh: modena lach deikka meila midderabbanan. vekashya li: mi ikka midde demeikkara la it beh meila, ulevassof it beh meila?
Vela? veha ikka dam, demeikkara let ba meila, ulevassof it ba meila, ditnan: dam, battechilla – en moalin bo, yatza lenachal kidron – moalin bo!
Amri: hatam name ikka meila meikkara,
b: Deamar rav: hammakkiz dam levehemat kadashim, asur bahanaa, umoalin bo.
Gufa. amar rav huna, amar rav: hammakkiz dam levehemat kadashim – asur bahanaa, umoalin bo. metiv rav hamenuna chalev hammukedashin, uvetze torin – lo nehenin velo moalin!
Amar leh: ki kaamrinan, legabbe dam, delo mitkayyemet bela dam. aval chelev, deka mikkayyma belo chelev – la.
Metiv rav mesharsheya: hazzevel vehapperesh shebbechatzer – en nehenin veen moalin. veyippelu dameha lallishka.
Ammay? hacha name, la mekayyem belo peresh! amri: may irya, haden peresh demin alma kaate la, azel hay – ate acharina. leappoke dam, miggufa.
Ha katane lo nehenin velo moalin vedamav lallishka. mesayyeya leh lerabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar: kol makom sheamru chachamim kadosh veeno kadosh – damav yippelu lallishka.
Mishna chalev hammukedashin uvetze torin – lo nehenin velo moalin.
Bamme devarim amurim – bekodshe mizbeach. aval bekodshe bedek habbayit, hikdish tarnegolet – moalin bah uvevetzatah, chamora – moalin bah uvachalavah.
Gemara ella gabbe mizbeach, ki akdesha kedushshat damim, la it ba meila?

Amar rav pappa: chassore michassera vehachi katane: bamme devarim amurim – keshehikdish kedushshat hagguf legabbe mizbeach, aval hikdisho kedushshat damim legabbe mizbeach – naasa kemi shehikdisho levedek habbayit. hikdish tarnegolet – moalin bah uvevetzatah, chamora – moalin bah uvachalavah.
Mishna, kol harauy lammizbeach

a: Velo levedek habbayit, levedek habbayit velo lammizbeach, lo lammizbeach velo levedek habbayit – moalin bah. ketzad?
Hikdish bor male mayim, ashpot meleot zevel, shovach male yonim,
Ilan male perot, sade melea asavim –
Moalin bahem uvema shebbetochah.

Aval im hikdish bor veachar kach nitmalle mayim, ashpa veachar kach nitmalla zevel, shovach veachar kach nitmalle yonim, ilan veachar kach nitmalle perot, sade veachar kach nitmallea asavim – moalin bahem, veen moalin bema shebbetochah.
Rabbi yose omer: hammakdish et hassade vehailan – moalin bahen uvegiddulah, mippene shehen giddule hekdesh.
Velad hameusseret – lo yinak min hameusseret, vaacherim mitnaddevim ken. velad hammukedashin – lo yinak min hammukedashin, vaacherim mitnaddevim ken.
Happoalim lo yochlu min gerogrot hekdesh. vechen para mikkarshine hekdesh.
Gemara katane: velad hameusseret lo yinak min hameusseret. menahane mille?
Amar rav achadvuy bar amme: atya "haavara" "haavara" mibbechor, ma bechor moalin bo – af chalev hameusseret moalin bo.
Chalev hammukedash name, atya "immo" "immo" mibbechor.
Happoalin lo yochlu kulei. may tama? amar rav achadvuy bar amme deamar kera: "lo tachsom shor bedisho", "disho" – shellecha, velo disho shel hekdesh.
Haddash kalilin bisde hekdesh – maal. veha betalush bainan! amar ravina: shema minna avka mealle la.
b: Mishna shorshe ilan shel hedyot habbain beshel hekdesh, veshel hekdesh shebbain beshel hedyot – lo nehenin velo moalin. mayan shehu yotze mittoch hassade shel hekdesh – lo nehenin velo moalin. yatza chutz lassade – nehenin mimmennu.
Hammayim shebbakkad shel zahav – lo nehenin velo moalin. netanan bitzlochit – moalin bahen.
Arava – lo nehenin velo moalin. rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer: nohagin hayu hazzekenim shennehenim mimmennu belulevehen.
Gemara amar resh lakish: en moalin bechullan, aval moalin beshalosh luggin.
Vehakatane sefa: "netano litzlochit – moalin bahen", mikkelal deresha afillu bishloshet luggin name la!
Ella i ittemar assefa ittemar. moalin bahen, amar resh lakish: en moalin ella bishlosha luggin.
Verabbi yochanan amar – moalin bechullan. lememra dekasavar resh lakish: yesh shiur lammayim, vehatnan, amar rabbi eliezer: hamenassech me chag, bechag bachutz – chayyayv.
Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum menachem yodafa: rabbi elazar beshitat rabbi akiva amar, dedaresh "niskehem" – echad nissuch hammayim, veechad nissuch hayyayin.
Veamar resh lakish: i ma yayin shalosh luggin, af mayim shalosh luggin! mikkelal desavar resh lakish en shiur lammayim! letama dimnachem yodafa, kaamar.
Mishna hakken shebberosh hailan shel hekdesh – la nehenin velo moalin. shebbaashera – yattiz bekane. hammakdish et hachoresh – moalin bechullo.

a: Gemara ittemar, avoda zara shennishtabbera meeleha. rabbi yochanan amar: asura. veresh lakish amar: mutteret.
Rabbi yochanan amar asura – dela battela goy. veresh lakish amar mutteret – memar amar: hi gufa la matztzela, ledidi matztzela li?
Etiveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: hakken shebberosh hailan shel hekdesh – en nehenin veen moalin. shebbaashera yattiz bekane.
May lav deittevar miggufa, vekatane, yattiz bekane? la, deayyti etzim mealma.
I hachi, ammay shel hekdesh en nehenin veen moalin?
Ella, begiddulin habbain leachar mikkan, vekasavar en moalin begiddulin.
Hachi name mistabbera, dei salka datach deayyti mealma, ammay yattiz bekane? lishkeleh mishkal!
Amar rabbi avahu, amar rabbi yochanan: leolam deayyti mealma, umay "yattiz"? yattiz efrochim.
Amar leh: rabbi yaakov lerabbi yirmeya efrochim kan vechan – muttarin. betzim, kan vechan – asurin. amar rav ashe: im efrochim tzerichin leimman – kevetzim damu.
Mishna haggizbarim shellakchu etzim – moalin baetzim, veen moalin lo bashshippuyy velo banneviyyay.
Gemara amar shemuel: bonin bachol veachar kach makdishin.
May tama? man demitnaddev maot makdesh lehu, deamar: "techul kedushshat maot abbinyan",
Vihev lehon leummanin bischaran.
b: Metivi: motar hakketoret ma hayu osin bo? hayu mafrishin mimmenna sechar haummanin.
Umechallelin otah al meot haummanin, venotnin otah laummanin, vechozrin venotlin otah mitteruma chadasha.
Veammay? laychalay abbinyan!
Dela ikka binyan. veha "meot haummanin" katane! delekka binyan keshiur maot.
Vehaamar shemuel: hekdesh shave mane shechillelo al shave peruta – mechullal! hane mille dei avad, lechattechilla – la.
Rav pappa amar: hayeynu tama devonin bachol – lo nittena tora lemalache hashsharet, imre dilma bae lemizga, uzega alayyhu. i bena bekudesha – ishtechach dekamael bekudesha.
Tenan: haggizbarin shellakchu et haetzim – moalin bahen, veen moalin lo bashshippuyy velo banneviyyay.
Veammay moalin bahen? hacha name lebad bachol, amri dedilma bae lemizga, uzega alehen, veishtechach deka moel bekadashim!
Amar rav pappa: i beetzim demikkan veelach, hachi name. ella ki tenan bematnitin, beetzim deyomeh.
Haderan alach velad chattat

a: Kodshe mizbeach, mitztarfin ze im ze limila ulechayyev alehem mishshum piggul venotar vetame. kodshe bedek habbayit mitztarfin ze im ze. echad kodshe mizbeach veechad kodshe bedek habbayit mitztarfin ze im ze limila.

Gemara hasheta yesh lomar dekatane: "echad kodshe mizbeach veechad kodshe bedek habbayit" dehay kedushshat hagguf vehay kedushshat damim, afillu hachi katane: "mitztarfin ze im ze". "kodshe mizbeach im kodshe mizbeach" mibbaya?
Mishshum dekatane ala "lechayyev alehen mishshum piggul notar vetame", dekodshe bedek habbayit la ikka hachi, mishshum hachi ka pelig leh.
Amar rabbi yannay: mechavvavrta, en chayyayvin mishshum meila ella al kodshe bedek habbayit veola bilvad. may tama? deamar kera: "nefesh ki timol maal mikkodshe Adonai",
Kodashim hameyuchadin laAdonai – yesh bahen meila. aval kodshe mizbeach – it behu lakkohanim, veit behu labbealim.
Tenan: kodshe mizbeach mitztarfin ze im ze limila! midderabbanan.
Kodshe kadashim sheshshechatan baddarom – moalim bahen! midderabbanan.
Tenan: hannehene min hachattat keshehi chayya – lo maal ad sheyyifgom. keshehi meta, kevan shennehena kol shehu – maal! midderabbanan.
Umiddeorayyta la? vehatanya, rabbi omer: "kol chelev laAdonai" – lerabbot emure kadashim kallim limila!
Midderabbanan. veha kera ka nasev la! asmachta bealma.

Veha amar ulla, amar rabbi yochanan: kadashim shemmetu – yatzu mide meila devar tora. bemay? ilema bekodshe bedek habbayit, afillu ki metu name, la yehe ella deakdesh ashpa levedek habbayit, lav it ba meila?
Ella kodshe mizbeach, deorayyta! mi it behu meila?
Ella hachi ka amri deve rabbi yannay: mehay kera kodshe bedek habbayit shamin minna, kodshe mizbeach la shamin minna.
b: Mishna chamishsha devarim baola mitztarfin ze im ze: habbasar, vehachelev, vehassolet, vehayyayin, vehashshemen. veshishsha battoda: habbasar, vehachelev, vehassolet, vehayyayin, vehashshemen vehallechem.

Gemara matne leh rav huna lerava: "chamishsha devarim baolam mitztarfin ze im ze". amar leh: "baolam" ka amrat? veha katane battoda "shishsha devarim shebbattoda – habbasar vehachelev vehassolet vehayyayin vehashshemen velachme toda"! amar leh: teni "baola".
Tenena leha detanu rabbanan: olot veemurim mitztarfin lichzayit lehaalotan bachutz, ulechayyev alehen mishshum piggul venotar vetame.

Katane: beola – in, bishlamim – la. bishlama lehaalotan bachutz, ola dechalil hi – mitztarfin, shelamim – la mitztarfin. ella lechayyev alehen mishshum piggul venotar vetame, shelamim ammay la mechayyev?
Vehatnan: kol happiggulim mitztarfin ze im ze, vechol hannotarot mitztarfot zo im zo!
Ella ema: ola veemureha mitztarfin ze im ze lichzayit lizrok alehen et haddam.
Vechevan demitztarfin lizrok et haddam – chayyayv vechulei.

Uman katane la? rabbi yehoshua hi, detanya: rabbi yehoshua omer: kol hazzevachim shebbattora shennishtayyer mehen kezayit basar uchezayit chelev – zorek et haddam, kachatzi zayit basar vechachatzi zayit chelev – eno zorek et haddam.
Uvaola, afillu kachatzi zayit basar vechachatzi zayit chelev – zorek et haddam, mippene shekkullah kalil. uvammincha, afillu kullah kayyemet – lo yizrok.
Mincha may avidtay? amar rav pappa: minchat nesachim.

Mishna hatteruma, uterumat maaser, uterumat maaser shel demay, vehachalla, vehabbikkurim – mitztarfin ze im ze leesor ulechayyev alehen et hachomesh. kol happiggulim – mitztarfin ze im ze. vechol hannotarim – mitztarfin ze im ze.
Gemara may tama? kullehu ikkeru "teruma". gabbe challa ketiv: "reshit arisotechem challa tarimu teruma",
Gabbe bikkurim name ikkeru "teruma", detanya: "uterumat yadecha" – ellu bikkurim, aval inach – la tzericha.
Mishna kol hannevelot – mitztarfin zo im zo. vechol hashshekatzim – mitztarfin ze im ze.
Gemara amar rav:

a: Lo shanu ella leinyan tumea, aval leinyan achila – tehorin bifne atzman, utemeim bifne atzman. velevi amar: afillu laachila name mitztarfin.
Verav assi amar: tehorim leatzman utemein leatzman. ikka deamri: peliga adderav, veikka deamri: la peliga.
Metivi: mitat para, vechayye gamal – en mitztarfin ze im ze. ha mitat shenehem – mitztarfin, vekashya lerav assi!
Ema: ha chayye shenehem – mitztarfin, umanni – rabbi yehuda hi, deamar: ever min hachay noheg battemea.
Aval mitat shenehem, may? la mitztarfi? im ken, may irya derahet vetane "mitat para vechayye gamal", ha afillu mitat shenehem la mitztarfi!

Veod, tanya: chatzi zayit para bechayyeha vachatzi zayit gamal bemitatah – en mitztarfin. aval chatzi zayit mippara vachatzi zayit miggamal, ben bechayyeha ben bemitatah – mitztarfin. kashya resha assefa! ella lav shema minna: mitat shenehem – mitztarfin!?
Amar lecha rav assi: hay tanna savar issur chal al issur.
b: Amar rav yehuda, amar rav: achilat sheratzim – loke alav bichzayit. may tama? 'achila ketiv behu.

Vehatane rabbi yose bar rabbi chanina kammeh derabbi yochanan: "vehivdaltem ben habbehema hattehora lattemea uven haof hattame lattahor velo teshakketzu et nafshotechem babbehema uvaof uvechol asher tirmos haadama asher hivdalti lachem letamme" – patach hakkatuv baachila, vesiyyem betumea.
Ma tumea bechaadasha, af achila bechaadasha. vekalleseh rabbi yochanan, vekashya lidrav!
La kashya: kan – bemitatan, kan – bechayyehen.

Amar leh abbaye: veha rav ammatnitin kae, umatnitin "kol hashsheratzim" katane, afillu bemitatan. lav deikka pureta mehay ufureta mehay? amar leh rav yosef: hahi diyyuka dilach hu. rav – shemata bealma kaamar.
Vekalleseh rabbi yochanan. metivi: haevarin – en lahen shiur, afillu pachot mikkezayit nevela ufachot mikkaadasha min hashsheretz – metammein. veamar rabbi yochanan: en lokin alehen ella bichzayit!
Amar rava: bemuvedalin dibber hakkatuv.
Amar leh rav adda bar ahava lerava: ella meatta, behema name, liflegi ben muvedelet lesheenah muvedelet.

a: Amar leh: ki ka makkesh rachamana – leval teshakketzu, aval leshiurin – la.
Mishna dam hashsheretz vehabbasar – mitztarfin ze im ze. kelal amar rabbi yehoshua: kol shettumeato veshiuro shavin – mitztarfin.
Tumeato velo shiuro, shiuro velo tumeato, lo tumeato [velo] shiuro – en mitztarfin.
Gemara amar rav chanin amar rav zeera,
Vechen amar rabbi yose bar rabbi chanina: "hattemein" – melammed shehen mitztarfin, vaafillu sheretz vasheretz, sheretz vadam, ben mishshem echad, ben mishshene shemot!
Amar rav yosef: la kashya, kan – bechullo. kan – bemiktzato.
Umena temra? middetanya: nishpach al haritzpa vehaya mekomah katafres, ihel al miktzato – tahor, ihel al kullo – tame.
May "miktzato"? illema miktzat dam, veha amar rabbi chanina amar rabbi: reviit dam shehegis bah – tehora!
Ella lav shema minna: kan – bechullo, kan – bemiktzato? shema minna.
Shaal rabbi matya ben charash et rabbi shimon ben yochay bair romi: minnayin ledam sheratzim shehu tame? amar leh: deamar kera: "veze lachem hattame".

Amru lo talmidav: chachem leh ben yochay. amar lahem: talmud aruch befiv shel rabbi elazar bar rabbi yose. sheppaam achat gazra hammalchut gezera shello yishmeru et hashshabbat, veshello yamulu et benehem, vesheyyivalu et niddot.

Halach rabbi reuven ben isterobbali, vesipper kome, vehalach veyashav immahem. amar lahem: mi sheyyesh lo oyev, yaani o yaashir? amru lo: yaani. amar lahem: im ken, lo yaasu melacha bashshabbat, kede sheyyaanu! amru: tavet amar, livtal, uvitteluha.
Chazar veamar lahem: mi sheyyesh lo oyev, yachchish o yavri? amru lo: yachchish. amar lahem: im ken, yamulu benehem lishmona yamim veyachchishu. amru: tavet amar, uvitteluha.
Chazar veamar lahem: mi sheyyesh lo oyev, yirbe o yitmaet? amru lo: yitmaet. im ken, lo yivalu niddot. amru: tavet amar, uvitteluha.
Hikkiru bo shehu yehudi, hechezirum. amru: mi yelech vivattel haggezerot?
b: Yelech rabbi shimon ben yochay, shehu melummad benissim. veacharav mi yelech? rabbi elazar bar rabbi yose.

Amar lahem rabbi yose: veillu haya abba chalafta kayyaym, yecholin attem lomar lo: ten bincha lahariga? amar lahem Rabbi shimon: illu haya yochay abba kayyaym, yecholin attem lomar lo: ten bincha lahariga?
Amar lehu rabbi yose: ana azlin, dilma anesh leh rabbi shimon, deka mistefena. kabbel aleh dela linesheh. afillu hachi, ansheh.

Keshehayu mehallechin badderech, nishala sheela zo bifnehem: minnayin ledam hashsheretz shehu tame? ikkem piv rabbi elazar bar rabbi yose, veamar: "veze lachem hattame". amar leh rabbi shimon: meakimat sefatecha atta nikkar shettalmid chacham atta, al yachzor habben etzel aviv.
Yatza likrato ben temalyon: retzonchem avo immachem? bacha rabbi shimon veamar: ma shifcha shel bet abba, nizdammen lah malach shalosh peamim. vaani, lo paam achat? yavo hannes mikkol makom.

Kedem hu, al bivratteh dekesar. ki meta hatam, amar: ben temalyon, tze! ben temalyon, tze! vechevan dikro leh, nefak azal. amar lehon: sheilu kol ma deit lechon lemishal. veayyeylinhu leginzeh lishkol kol devau. ashkachu hahu iggera, shakluha ukerauha.
Vehayeynu deamar rabbi elazar bar rabbi yose: ani reitiha bair romi, vahavo aleha kamma tippe damim.
Mishna happiggul vehannotar – en mitztarfin, mippene shehen shene shemot. hashsheretz vehannevela, vechen hannevela uvesar hammet – en mitztarfin ze im ze letamme, afillu bakkal shebbishnehen.

Gemara amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo shanu ella letumeat hayyadayim, demidderabbanan hi. aval leinyan achila – mitztarfin. detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: "lo yeachel ki kodesh hu" – kol shebbakkodesh pasul, ba hakkatuv litten lo taase al achilato.
Mishna haochel shennitma beav hattumea, veshennitma bivlad hattumea – mitztarfin ze im ze letamme bakkal shebbishnehem. kol haochalim mitztarfin ze im ze lifsol haggeviyyay kevachatzi feras.

Kevimzon shete seudot leeruv, uchevetza letamme tumeat ochalin, vechigrogeret lehotzaat shabbat, uchechotevet beyom hakkippurim. kol hammashkin mitztarfin zo im zo lifsol et haggeviyyay birviit, vechimlo lugema beyom hakkippurim.
Gemara tanya, rabbi shimon omer: ma taam? sheefshar lashsheni sheyyease rishon. umi ka aved sheni rishon? ha la efshar!
Amar rava, hachi kaamar: mi garam lashsheni? lav rishon?! rav ashe amar: rishon vesheni, legabbe shelishi – bene chada bikta innun.

a: Mishna haorla vechile hakkerem – mitztarfin ze im ze. rabbi shimon omer: en mitztarfin.
Gemara umi tzarich rabbi shimon letzarofe? vehatanya, rabbi shimon omer: kol shehu lemakkot? teni: en tzerichin letzaref.
Mishna habbeged vehassak, hassak vehaor, haor vehammappatz – kullan mitztarfin ze im ze.
Amar rabbi shimon: ma taam? mippene shehen reuyin littame bemoshav.
Gemara tana: kitztza mikkullan shelosha, veasa mehen beged lemishkav – shelosha, lemoshav – tefach, laachiza – kol shehu.
May laachiza? amar resh lakish, amar rabbi yannay: shekken omed lenavvla. bematnita tana: hoil verauy lekotztze teenim.
Haderan alach kodshe mizbeach

Hannehene min hahekdesh shave peruta, af al pi shello pagam – maal, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim: kol davar sheyyesh bo pegam – lo maal, ad sheyyifgom. vesheen bo pegam, kevan shennehena – maal.
Ketzad? natna katla betzavvarah, tabbaat beyadah, shata bechos shel zahav, kevan shennehena – maal. lavash bechaluk, kissa betallit, bikka bekardom – lo maal ad sheyyifgom.
Hannehene min hachattat, keshehi chayya – lo maal, ad sheyyifgom. keshehi meta, kevan shennehena – maal.
Gemara: tana: mode rabbi akiva lachachamim bedavar sheyyesh bo pegam. bemay ka mippalgi?!
Amar rava: bilvush metziaa, umalmela.
Tanu rabbanan: "nefesh" – echad hayyachid, veechad hannasi, veechad hammashiach.
"Ki timol maal", en "maal" ella shinnuy, vechen hu omer: "ish ish ki tiste ishto umaala vo maal", veomer: "vayyimalu belohe
b: Avotehem vayyiznu achare habbealim".
Yachol pagam velo nehena, o nehena velo pagam,
Uvimchubbar lakkarka, uveshaliach sheasa shelichuto?
Talmud lomar "vechata". neemar: "chet" bitruma, veneemar: "chet" bimila.
Ma "chet" haamur bitruma, pogem venehene, umi sheppagam nehene, uvaddavar sheppogem bo nehene, ufegimato vahanaato keechad, uvetalush min hakkarka, uveshaliach sheasa shelichuto –
Af "chet" haamur bimila, pogem venehene, umi sheppagam nehene, uvaddavar sheppogem bo nehene, ufegimato vahanaato keechad, uvetalush min hakkarka, uveshaliach sheasa shelichuto.
En li ella ochel, venehene bedavar sheen bo pegam, minnayin?
Achilato vaachilat chavero, hanayayto vahanayayt chavero, hanaato vaachilat chavero, achilato vahanayayt chavero shemmitztarfin ze im ze, afillu lizman merubbe, minnayin?
Talmud lomar: "timol maal" – mikkol makom.

I ma "chet" haamur bitruma – lo tzeraf shete achilot keechad, af "chet" haamur bimila – lo tzeraf shete achilot keachad. minnayin achal hayyom veachal lemachar, vaafillu lizman merubbe? talmud lomar: "timol maal" – mikkol makom.
I ma "chet" haamur bitruma – pegimato vahanaato keechad, minnayin laachilato vaachilat chavero? vaafillu mikkan vead shalosh shanim, minnayin? talmud lomar: "timol maal" – mikkol makom.
I ma "chet" haamur bitruma
